---
title: "Golden Retriever Life Expectancy and Weight"
subtitle: "2,500 observations examining canine longevity and health"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: graphic
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6

library(tidyverse)

dogs <- read_csv("golden_retrievers.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(
    activity_level = factor(activity_level, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High")),
    overall_health = factor(overall_health, levels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Excellent"))
  )

dogs |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = weight_lbs, y = lifespan_years, color = gender)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Weight vs. Life Expectancy in Golden Retrievers",
    subtitle = "Observations of 2,500 dogs showing the relationship between weight and life expectancy",
    x = "Weight (lbs)",
    y = "Life Expectancy (years)",
    color = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

This graphic displays 2,500 observations of Golden Retrievers, illustrating how body weight and gender relate to overall life expectancy.
